build_mae_image_classification_model: build a MaeImageClassificationModel from a config with pretrained weights and classification head
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on image tensors through the MAE classification model with optional labels
configure_prediction_mode: configure the model to use MEAN_POOLING, CLS_TOKEN, or LIN_SOFTMAX prediction mode for classification
setup_mixup_augmentation: setup mixup and cutmix data augmentation with configurable probability and label smoothing
assign_layer_decay: assign layer-wise learning rate decay scales to ViT model parameters following BEiT strategy
